run_sweep.title: Start a sweep job
run_sweep.description: Starts a sweep job from its specification, the same JSON file spikypanda-job reads, and returns a job id and the plan the factory computed. A job is the long form of a study (a full grid, a fit, an evaluation over scenarios); it needs the operator's approval, which the harness requests before the call. For a quick what-if, ask the twin instead: it answers in milliseconds.

job_status.title: Read a job's state
job_status.description: Returns the state of a job (queued, running, completed, failed or refused) with its exit code and its start and end times. Reading is free and needs no approval.

get_artifact.title: Read a job's output file
get_artifact.description: Returns one file of a job's outputs: small files inline with their sha256, large ones by location and sha256, never the bytes themselves. Reading is free and needs no approval.
